_doc: Frozen JSON-Schema snapshot of klodi_search + klodi_searches_create params + result, generated from the TypeBox catalog at packages/tool-catalog/src/index.ts. Carries the stable-contract gate (PO SC-contract.2): diffing the current catalog's serialised schemas against this snapshot detects removals / renames / retypes / Optional→required-promotions. Additive changes (new Type.Optional fields) are permitted and require a coordinated snapshot bump in the same PR — never a silent regeneration. The TypeBox→JSON-Schema serialisation is the `.params` / `.result` object itself; TypeBox emits JSON-Schema-shaped objects natively. See ADR-0011 envelope-golden for the precedent (snapshot-tested cross-language contract).

klodi_search._doc: klodi_search params + result, frozen as of card tool-service-search-parity-verification RED phase. The catalog is packages/tool-catalog/src/index.ts:353-377. params are ALL optional (query / category / min_price / max_price / delivery / condition / limit / cursor); result is the {results: ListingSearchSummary[], total: int} pair the marketplace returns.

delivery.description: Buyer's delivery preference. Pick the variant matching the buyer's intent — fields from one variant cannot appear on another (the type system rejects it).

radiusKm.description: Km radius around buyer's profile location. Omit for any-distance pickup match.

to.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)

klodi_searches_create._doc: klodi_searches_create params + result, frozen as of card tool-service-search-parity-verification RED phase. The catalog is packages/tool-catalog/src/index.ts:379-411. `slug` is REQUIRED; criteria fields (query / category / min_price / max_price / delivery) are optional. Result includes the canonical `criteria` object the marketplace records — proves the registration payload reached the service intact.

slug.description: Stable client-chosen slug. Last-write-wins per (user, slug).

delivery.description: Buyer's delivery preference. Pick the variant matching the buyer's intent — fields from one variant cannot appear on another (the type system rejects it).

radiusKm.description: Km radius around buyer's profile location. Omit for any-distance pickup match.

to.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)
